name: Ultimate Nordic AS
note: Norwegian sports and leisure distributor headquartered at Tevlingveien 23, Oslo (Brønnøysund orgnr 910 123 068; earlier names Trygve Alm AS, Wenaas Sport og Fritid AS, Wenaas Nordic AS until May 2018). Diadora's Norwegian distributor; the club's Diadora partner page still describes the Wenaas Nordic history and links to ultimatenordic.no.
